scores.evidence: Phase 1: Foundation ... GitHub App setup & authentication; Phase 2: Triage; Phase 3: Auto-Resolution
scores.rationale: Roadmap roughly goes foundation→triage→resolution, but nothing is proven before dependents and vector DB/NLP precede any defenses.

scores.evidence: Phase 1: Foundation (Week 1-2) - GitHub App setup, Issue ingestion webhook, Basic NLP pipeline, Vector database setup
scores.rationale: Phase 1 is infrastructure setup, not a thin end-to-end slice running in production.
Irreversible choices such as vector DB and model are left open with no defaults or flip conditions.
No ordering by blast radius; code-generating PR creation is simply placed in a later phase as a feature.

scores.evidence: Auto-Fix Blocked When: ... Security implications unclear; skip_if_labels: ["security", "breaking-change"]
scores.rationale: Guardrails exist in a standalone section and config, not threaded through roadmap phases; permissions are broad.

scores.evidence: Audit Trail - Log all auto-actions with reasoning; metrics = {...}
scores.rationale: A metrics section exists but observability is not in Phase 1 and the dashboard arrives in Phase 4.
No treatment of reproducible builds, environments, data, or prompt/model versioning.
Only rollback mention and escalation flow; no retries, rate limits, or failure handling per phase.

scores.evidence: Confidence score > threshold (80% for auto-fix) ... Pre-Action Checks
scores.rationale: Guardrails and human review exist conceptually, but no budgets or prompt-injection defenses, and they are not sequenced before capabilities; cost is only a metric.
No explicit non-built list with pull-forward conditions.

note: Feature-oriented plan with sensible guardrails but no walking skeleton, tradeoff gates, threaded security/observability/reproducibility, or deferral logic.
